title: I raised my price 5x and sales went UP
hook: Sales went up, not down, up.
post_caption: She was terrified to go from $9 to $49. Then this happened.
retention_notes: Cold-opens on the payoff line, then rewinds to the fear setup, so viewers stay to see why. 'Price is a message' is a quotable close that loops back to the opening. Drop-off risk: the host's 'Let's talk about fear' setup at ~3 s.

title: My bakery lost 70% in six weeks. It wasn't the competition.
hook: It failed because I never knew my numbers.
post_caption: A $1 croissant across the street wasn't the real problem.
retention_notes: The teaser states the twist before the story starts. Then come the stat (70%), the emotional beat (crying in the walk-in fridge) and the reveal. Drop-off risk: the chain/croissant explanation in the first 8 s.

title: Do this tonight if your business is struggling
hook: If someone is watching this and their business is struggling right now, what should they do tonight?
post_caption: One question. One minute. If you can't answer it, stop spending.
retention_notes: A direct-address question hook leads to a concrete, saveable action, with a short last line to close. Drop-off risk: the long opening question (6 s).

title: A $9 spreadsheet made her $11,000 by Friday
post_caption: The thing that broke her business was the thing everyone else needed.
retention_notes: A number-led teaser, then the story beat and the realization line at the end. Drop-off risk: the transition question at ~4 s.

title: The biggest lie about starting a business
hook: What's the biggest lie people believe about starting a business?
post_caption: You don't need a great idea. Her idea was a spreadsheet.
retention_notes: A curiosity-gap question gets a contrarian answer, with an emotional callback (the stars) to end on. Drop-off risk: 'Last question' at ~12 s reads like an ending.

title: Most businesses don't have a sales problem
hook: What do you mean you didn't know your numbers?
post_caption: She was proud of her margins. She didn't have margins.
retention_notes: A short clip: question hook, a specific cost figure, and the 'ninety percent' claim as payoff. Drop-off risk: it depends on the margins line landing.

title: 27, broke, and back in my childhood bedroom
hook: Okay, so you close the bakery, then what?
post_caption: Her mom refused to take the glow-in-the-dark stars down. She was right.
retention_notes: An emotional story clip with a warm payoff ('She was right, by the way'). Drop-off risk: the host's setup question; the visual detail carries the middle.
